sheet_symmetry.PSp_equivariant_sheet_permutation_group: S3 on the three identical copies

theorem: The three degree-36 half-spinor orbits are three genuine PSp-equivariant copies of the same 36-spread carrier. The PSp building centralizer supplies a sheet 3-cycle and the PGSp involution supplies a transposition, realizing S3 on the copy fiber inside the type-preserving normalizer.
